hardware: Intel Core i7-8565U, 4 physical / 8 logical cores, AVX2+FMA

formula_runtime.avx512: Compiled with runtime CPU/OS dispatch; not executable on the local CPU. Hosted CPU workflow tests it only when available.
formula_runtime.reproducible_build: Two different output directories produced identical SHA-256 after pinning PE image base and disabling timestamps.

hosted_avx512_checks.coverage: 16 unaligned/tail shapes for baseline, AVX2 and AVX-512; four dispatch modes; persistent four-worker jobs. Kernel numerical checks, not a full AVX-512 model-accuracy/speed benchmark.

checks.cpu_kernels: 16 shapes each on baseline and AVX2, unaligned inputs/tails; persistent four-worker pool, 100 jobs. AVX-512 explicitly skipped on unsupported local hardware.

target_formula.scope: Four-line derivation from the user-provided Elsevier paper; all four rows, both L21/L22 terms, accents, fractions and norm bars checked against the image.
target_formula.old_model: Both whole-formula controls reached the external 90-second timeout. Its single-row control was faster but lost symbols.
target_formula.mathml: All three target outputs converted to well-formed editable MathML.

publisher_corpus.scope: Identical frozen 144-DPI crops, some containing adjacent/partial prose. Completion is not accuracy. Manual review found substitutions in accents, subscripts and symbols. No exact-match accuracy benchmark or universal improvement is claimed.

translation_and_text_ocr: Existing Hy-MT2 and PP-OCRv6 weights/runtime payloads are reused verbatim. Prior 1.0.2 full-suite counts are historical, not newly repeated 1.1.0 checks.
portable_verification: Final EXE checks are recorded separately after packaging.
limits: Difficult formula transcription still requires original-image review. High confidence is not proof of correctness.
AVX-512 speed and model outputs have not been measured on the local CPU.
Installed MathType was unavailable; XML/clipboard structures were checked, not an actual MathType paste.
No new physical GPU benchmark was performed. Private papers and crops are excluded from the repository and release.
